ownership_summary: Controlled by Joe Lacob and Peter Guber, who bought the team in 2010 for $450 million; the holding company is Golden State Group (Warriors, Valkyries, Santa Cruz Warriors, Chase Center, Thrive City). Arctos Sports Partners bought about 5% in 2021 and raised it to about 13% in Dec 2021 at a $5.5bn valuation; SBJ/Bloomberg (Jan 2026) put Arctos at about 15%. KKR agreed in Feb 2026 to acquire Arctos, so the stake sits in KKR Solutions. In Jan 2026 a 5% GSG stake was marketed at above $11bn.
